userMessage: 加一个按钮：按住按钮时两个 LED 都亮，松开时两个都灭。
summary:
已为你规划好：新增两个 LED（红、绿，各配 220 Ω 限流电阻）和一个按钮。LED1 接 GPIO4、LED2 接 GPIO5，按钮一端接 GPIO3、另一端接 GND，GPIO3 启用内部上拉（按下 = 低电平）。固件每 10 ms 轮询一次按钮：按住时两个 LED 同时点亮，松开时两个同时熄灭（响应延迟 ≤10 ms，无闪烁渐变，只用普通 GPIO 高低电平，不涉及 PWM/ADC 等未仿真外设）。验证场景会在 4600 ms 内执行“按下→松开→再按下→再松开”两次循环，并逐段检查两个 LED 的亮灭状态与日志证据（按下两灯亮、松开两灯灭）。

虚拟验证通过 (virtual simulation verification passed — not physical hardware):
✓ led1 stayed off from 50 to 450 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 50 to 450 ms
✓ led1 stayed on from 550 to 1450 ms
✓ led2 stayed on from 550 to 1450 ms
✓ led1 stayed off from 1550 to 2450 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 1550 to 2450 ms
✓ led1 stayed on from 2550 to 3450 ms
✓ led2 stayed on from 2550 to 3450 ms
✓ led1 stayed off from 3550 to 4450 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 3550 to 4450 ms
✓ UART output contains "BTN pressed: LEDs ON" (log evidence only — not a physical signal)
✓ UART output contains "BTN released: LEDs OFF" (log evidence only — not a physical signal)
